## Cat Key 1.8.0: the shortcut coach on a Mac

**⬇ [Download for Windows](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-Setup-x64.exe)** or the [portable exe](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-portable-x64.exe) · **[Download for Mac](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-mac.dmg)** (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11+).

### The shortcut coach, now on a Mac too
- **Click a menu item that has a shortcut** and a small note shows its keys, ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ and all, then fades. It works in every app, because Mac menus carry their own shortcuts: New Folder, Duplicate, Export, anything.
- **A window's close and minimise buttons** get a tip too (⌘W, ⌘M), and so do buttons the Library knows.
- **Ignore** a tip and it never comes back, **Dismiss** it for now, or **Adjust** it into a shortcut of your own. Put the note anywhere on screen. The **Coach** page is on the Mac now, with your catches, what you ignored and a switch per app, and the Cat Warrior page counts the time the mouse costs you.
- It reads only the name of what you clicked, through Accessibility (the permission Cat Key's keyboard already uses), the way VoiceOver does. Chrome-based apps are left out unless you switch them on, because answering costs them a little work.
- Coach tips can make their little sound on a Mac too (Settings → Sounds).

### Also new since 1.7
- **App switcher:** rest the pointer in a corner and your open windows pop up right there (Settings → App switcher).
- **Eight new app packs:** Notion, Slack, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Final Cut Pro, Ableton Live and Unity.

**Mac, first open:** Cat Key isn't notarized by Apple yet. Open it once, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. If that goes round in circles, paste this into Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Cat Key.app" && open "/Applications/Cat Key.app"`.
